problemH2: Don’t let a fear of blood catch you off guard
problemP: Appointments postponed, first aid avoided — the next glimpse always one surprise away. The villain is not you. It is a misfiring subconscious program — once meant to protect you, now firing indiscriminately.
quote: You are someone who stays steady when blood appears. That person already exists inside you.

externalP: Lightheaded, sweaty, or faint at the sight of blood.
internalP: Nearly going down. Avoiding situations where blood might appear.
deeperH3: A world fenced by one fear
deeperP: Care delayed. Panic at minor cuts. Peace you stopped trusting.
reliefP: By the end of your session you will feel your world shift. Stay present. Feel steady. Respond calmly.
